text:
sara: Heads-up — planning a staged shift for release v2.3.1 into production in tonight's change window (21:00–23:00 UTC). Target: 0→20% over 30m. Anyone object?

mike: quick note from QA — long-prompt embeds show ~2x tail latency at 15% in our perf tests. Not a full blocker but flagged.

nina: infra saw a KV-cache mem bump during the dry run on staging, pods crept towards 78% mem.

sara: ok — can we do an interim stop at 15% and do a fast health check? putting call to ops: hold/go

deploy-bot: [deploybot] initiating staged rollout v2.3.1 commit=8a7f3d4
deploy-bot: shift plan: 5% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m checks

yusuf: ops: logs look fine so far, but if KV-cache crosses 85% within 10m we should abort and pin back to v2.3.0

alexa: oncall: checking traces now, will report within 3m

ops-bot: health-signal: latency_p50 small increase, errors steady

deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 15% — gate OPEN but PAUSED per manual hold

mike: vote: hold until we confirm embed tail behavior isn't impacting UX. hold/:thumbsup:

nina: vote: go if we can pin at 15% and keep close monitoring. go/:thumbsup:

sara: +1 to holding at 15% while we run a short canary evaluation. I'm calling an explicit stop here. @deploy-bot keep at 15% and do not proceed.

deploy-bot: acknowledged — rollout paused at 15%. To continue reply `go`. To rollback reply `rollback`.

alexa: oncall update: traces show occasional GC spikes on model-infer-3; correlates with large-batch requests from a handful of clients.

yusuf: ops: recommendation = pin traffic at 15% and enable prefix caching fallback for model shard A for 30m. If OOM or >2x latency regressions, trigger rollback.

sara: creating rollback playbook + ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321 — attaching logs and probe queries

mike: I'll run the short eval set against staging-v2.3.1 vs production-v2.3.0 and post diffs in 10m.

nina: infra will toggle cache fallback if we see mem spike.

sara: final on-call decision: HOLD at 15% for 30m. executing pin to v2.3.0 for safety and triage workflow.

deploy-bot: pinning route: active -> v2.3.0 ; initiating rollback job to revert sessions routed to v2.3.1

ops-bot: rollback job started — progress: 0% -> 100% (expected 6m). Notifying monitoring channels.

deploy-bot: rollback complete. Live traffic now on v2.3.0. Please confirm when postmortem PR is ready.

sara: thanks team. I'll update release notes and send a short postmortem template. Noted to add KV-cache tuning to action items.

mike: noted. will add evaluation artifacts to the ticket.

nina: leaving a follow-up infra checklist in the ticket: increase cache headroom + warmup traffic test.

sara: closing loop — change window remains open for a hotfix deploy if needed. We'll reschedule the rollout after mitigations.

alexa: acked :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: event summary: v2.3.1 rollout paused at 15% -> rolled back per manual hold; rollback user=sara; ticket=INF-4321
